visual_text: Found: 86 in 100 reviewed had a recommendation
Acted on: about 6 in 10 of those had at least one change by 2 months
On an overused medicine at 2 months: about 42 in 100 in each group
Readmitted because of a medicine within a year: about 22 in 100 in each group
Did it change what patients value? Readmission for a medicine: no clear difference. Quality of life: about 2 points higher on a 100-point scale.
alt_text: Chain diagram of the OPERAM medicines review trial. Within the reviewed group: 86 in 100 had a recommendation; about 6 in 10 of those had at least one change by 2 months. Compared with control: about 42 in 100 on an overused medicine in each group; about 22 in 100 readmitted for a medicine within a year in each group. No clear difference in readmission; quality of life about 2 points higher.
design_instructions: Single card. Five boxes in two bracket groups: dashed grey left rule (within reviewed group, deep teal boxes with gold figures, claims C06-04-b, C06-04-c), solid orange left rule (compared with control, mint boxes, C06-04-d, C06-04-e), dotted rule for no clear difference box.
